name: safe-local-files
description: Audited access to one local directory through MCP; read-only by default with optional bounded writes.

interface.shortDescription: Read and search one approved local folder; optionally write text.
interface.longDescription: A local MCP plugin for bounded, audited file listing, search, metadata, and text retrieval. The owner may separately enable text creation, overwrite, and directory creation. It enforces a configured root, deny rules, secret detection, and resource limits.
defaultPrompt: Search my approved local folder for project notes.
Read a file from my approved local folder.
List the top level of my approved local folder.
